reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, so I already have a reason to try it, and $24.99 for the first box is an easy impulse buy on TikTok Shop. The lab report behind the QR code and the empty-box guarantee make it feel low risk.
objection: Made in China makes me nervous about what is really in it, even with a lab report. And it is still 2 capsules every day, which I will probably forget on a busy night.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report did not match the batch number on the box, or I saw reviews saying the guarantee was not honored.
